sloka: शर्वरीम् भवनन्न् अद्य सत्य शील तव आश्रमे ।उषिताः स्म इह वसतिम् अनुजानातु नो भवान् ॥२-५४-३७॥
transliteration: śarvarīm bhavanann adya satya śīla tava āśrame ।uṣitāḥ sma iha vasatim anujānātu no bhavān ॥2-54-37॥

translations.english: O venerable sage devoted to truth, we have spent the night in your hermitage. Please permit us to depart for the dwellingplace (suggested by you).
